form.p: This XML file is used to mass apply values to specific fields in records of a given model in Odoo.

ul.li: model – Odoo model where the records are located (e.g., account.account.tag)
field – The field where the value will be written
value – The value that will be written to the field
Text content – Filter indicating which records the value should be applied to (e.g., by IDs or codes)

pre.code: <configuration> <settings> <setting model="account.account.tag" field="l10n_bg_applicability" value="sale"> -11,+11,-12_1,-12_2,+12_1,+12_2,-13,+13,-14,+14,-15,+15,-16,+16,-17,+17,-18,+18,-19,+19,-21,+21,-22,+22,-23,+23,-24,+24 </setting> <setting model="account.account.tag" field="l10n_bg_applicability" value="purchase"> -30,+30,-31,+31,-32,+32,-41,+41,-42,+42 </setting> </settings> </configuration>

form.p: This file can be used by:

ul.li: A script that reads the XML and applies the values using Odoo ORM or XML-RPC
A localization or configuration module that automates the settings
An installation process where field values are set based on predefined criteria
